title: Extract information from audio · Level 3
slo: Identify the structured information an audio analyzer can return from a call.

exercises.question_text: What can the Foundry portal run on an audio file?

options.rationale: The portal can run an audio analyzer on a media file. It can return transcripts and extracted insights.
Document OCR reads printed text from images or scans. An audio file requires an audio analyzer.
options.better_fit: Use it for a scanned form or photographed document.

options.rationale: An invoice analyzer is intended for invoice content. It is not the appropriate tool for a recording.
options.better_fit: Use it when the uploaded file is an invoice.

options.rationale: Video attendance concerns people visible in visual media. It does not analyze a call recording.
options.better_fit: Use it for meeting video or images where attendance matters.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The portal can run an audio analyzer on an audio file.

exercises.question_text: Which outputs may be inspected after audio analysis? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Returned content may include markdown. Markdown is formatted plain text.
Returned content may include a transcript. It renders spoken audio as written text.
Returned content may include extracted fields. These provide structured details from the audio.
A paper document is an input medium, not an audio-analysis output. Results can include text and structured fields.
options.better_fit: Use a paper document as input for document analysis.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Audio analysis may return markdown, a transcript, and fields.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Results could be reviewed before any analysis has produced them.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Select and run the analyzer first, then review its outputs and JSON.

exercises.correct_answer: Select an audio analyzer run it on media review the outputs view JSON results
exercises.explanation: The analyzer must be selected and run before its outputs and JSON result can be reviewed.

exercises.question_text: Put the pieces in the correct order.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The definition would not clearly describe the transcript.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Start with the output name, then state that it is the written rendering of spoken audio content.

exercises.correct_answer: A transcript is the written rendering of spoken audio content
exercises.explanation: The sentence defines a transcript as the written rendering of spoken audio content.

exercises.question_text: Which parts are used in the Python audio analysis flow? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: The flow uses prebuilt-audioSearch for audio. This ID selects the prebuilt audio analyzer.
The flow supplies the audio through an accessible URL. The analyzer needs this input to start analysis.
The analysis operation is asynchronous. The flow waits for its result before inspection.
prebuilt-invoice is intended for invoices. The audio flow uses prebuilt-audioSearch.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The flow uses the audio ID, an accessible URL, and asynchronous analysis.

exercises.question_text: What can audio analysis create from a recorded call?

options.rationale: Audio analysis can create a transcription from recorded speech. It renders the call's spoken content as written words.
A printed-text scan concerns words visible in an image or page. Audio analysis works with spoken content.
options.better_fit: Use this for a scanned form or photographed receipt.

options.rationale: Invoice items are structured fields from an invoice. They do not represent a caller's speech.
options.better_fit: Use this when extracting line items from an invoice.

options.rationale: Attendance counts concern people visible in video or images. They are not written records of a call.
options.better_fit: Use this for a meeting video where attendance is needed.

exercises.explanation: Correct. A transcription creates a written record of spoken audio.

exercises.question_text: An audio analysis result may contain a transcript, extracted fields, or both.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Useful returned content from the call could be overlooked.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: The analyzer and schema determine whether the result contains a transcript, fields, or both.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The returned content may include a transcript, fields, or both.

exercises.question_text: A transcript is spoken audio shown as written text.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The written record of the call would be misidentified.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Speech recognition turns spoken audio into text; that written rendering is a transcript.

exercises.explanation: Correct. A transcript is the written rendering of spoken audio.

exercises.question_text: Which extracted detail is Ava's callback number?

options.rationale: 555-12345 is Ava's telephone number for a return call. It is the callback-number value.
Ava@contoso.com is an email address. It is an alternative contact detail, not a callback number.
options.better_fit: Use this when the field asks for an alternative email contact.

options.rationale: Ava from Contoso identifies who left the voicemail. It is not a telephone number.
options.better_fit: Use this when the field asks for the caller.

options.rationale: Meeting price expectations describes the voicemail topic. It belongs in a message summary, not a callback field.
options.better_fit: Use this when summarizing Ava's message.

exercises.question_text: Speech recognition turns spoken audio into ___.

parts.text: Speech recognition turns spoken audio into

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The output type would be named incorrectly.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Use text: OCR reads printed words in images, not spoken audio.

exercises.explanation: Speech recognition changes spoken audio into written text.

exercises.question_text: A developer must choose a reliable flow for a voicemail WAV file whose transcript and structured fields will be read after processing. Which choices should the developer select? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: prebuilt-audioSearch is the appropriate prebuilt analyzer for audio. It fits a voicemail WAV input.
The analysis flow requires an accessible URL to the voicemail file. This makes the audio available to the analyzer.
The operation is asynchronous, so results arrive after processing. Waiting prevents a premature attempt to read output.
prebuilt-invoice is designed for invoice content rather than audio. It is not a reliable choice for a voicemail WAV file.
options.better_fit: Use prebuilt-invoice when the input is an invoice requiring invoice-field extraction.

feedback.intrinsic: The selected analyzer would not fit the voicemail input.
feedback.instructional: Evaluate the media type first: a WAV voicemail requires prebuilt-audioSearch.

exercises.explanation: Use prebuilt-audioSearch for audio, provide an accessible voicemail URL, and wait or poll for the asynchronous operation to complete before reading the transcript and structured results.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The reply could use the wrong contact method.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Use Ava@contoso.com for the alternative contact detail.

exercises.explanation: Ava@contoso.com is Ava's alternative email contact. Her callback number is 555-12345.
